nodes.text: Meanwhile, the new "nautanki" of Citizenship Card should be staged to make everyone's life hell while Aadhaar has anyway been helping impostors siphon off money owing to false insurance claims and depriving genuine patients even of necessary medication by producing an ID crisis.

nodes.author: mesushovan
nodes.text: If the HMPV outbreak takes place, invariably, all brain-dead scoundrels of politics in power will impose a lockdown and equally dumb imbeciles in opposition will support that decision as, together, all those nincompoops think rape laws prevent rape, as if laws are "pre-emptive!"
